title: Connection-string password: one-property twin (context)
summary: 15 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is unchanged but the carrier lacks the marker that makes the value identifiable. Legacy mutation notes: context: userinfo has no ":" delimiter, so RFC 3986 assigns no password subcomponent; value unchanged. Twin of "Connection-string password: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of connection-string-mariadb-bare: context: userinfo has no ":" delimiter, so RFC 3986 assigns no password subcomponent; value unchanged. The value is unchanged and exactly one property of the assignment context differs; expected silence is project policy, as the positive's expectation is.
